game_tips.game: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
tips: Cooking a single Hearty Radish or Durian fully restores health and grants bonus temporary hearts!
You can parry Guardian laser beams with any shield—even a simple Pot Lid if you time it right!
Shield surfing down snowy peaks or grassy slopes is one of the fastest ways to travel!
Stuck climbing in the rain? Count five steps, then jump right before slipping down the wall!

game_tips.game: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
tips: Attach Keese Eyeballs to your arrows to give them automatic homing tracking on enemies!
Two Zonai Fans and a Steering Stick create the ultimate agile Hoverbike for exploring the Depths!
Always check ceilings for Ascend shortcuts—you can bypass entire cliffs and shrine obstacles!
Throwing Muddle Buds into enemy monster camps makes them fight each other while you watch!
Throw Cappy, hold Y, then perform a dive into Cappy to bounce and extend your jump distance!
Ground pound into glowing patches on the ground to reveal hidden Power Moons!
Capture a Goomba stack to safely walk on slippery icy surfaces without losing control!
Talking to Talkatoo in each kingdom provides subtle hints for remaining Power Moons!
Hold your drift longer to build up Purple Ultra Mini-Turbos for the biggest speed boost!
In 200cc, tap the B brake button while drifting to take sharp hairpins without flying off-track!
Drag a Banana or Green Shell behind you by holding ZL to shield against incoming Red Shells!
Look for subtle ramps and wave crests to tap the Jump button for quick Stunt Boosts!
Press Jump and Attack simultaneously to perform instantaneous Short-Hop Aerials!
Release your shield at the exact moment an attack lands to execute a Perfect Shield Parry!
Hold the directional stick inward while being launched to apply Directional Influence (DI) and survive!
Fast-falling by tapping down at the peak of your jump speeds up your neutral game significantly!
Use Flash Shift to dash through sensor doors before they close, or dodge sudden attacks!
Slide beneath charging E.M.M.I. to trigger a split-second melee counter opportunity!
Charge your Omega Stream cannon while retreating to keep distance from relentless pursuers!
Look for subtle cracks in walls—Power Bombs and Missiles reveal secret energy tanks!
Dig two holes behind your character before hitting rocks to get all 8 items without recoil!
Bury 10,000 Bells in glowing golden ground holes to grow Money Trees yielding 30,000 Bells!
Shake hardwood trees holding a net to catch wasps immediately when their nests fall!
Check the beach daily for message bottles with rare DIY crafting recipes from distant shores!
Crouch in tall grass and throw a Poké Ball at a Pokémon's back for a surprise backstrike bonus!
Use Smoke Bombs to create temporary cover when sneaking up on skittish Alpha Pokémon!
Always pay attention to weather conditions—rain boosts Water moves and weakens Fire attacks!
Check Tera Raid crystals each day for rare Herba Mystica and high IV Pokémon!
Squid Roll during swimming grants brief invulnerability armor frames against incoming shots!
Submerge in friendly ink whenever you need to reload your ink tank or heal up quickly!
Super Jump to teammates at spawn by using the D-Pad shortcuts on your map!
Inking the turf under your opponents slows them down and deals chip damage over time!

generic_tips: Don't forget to take a short stretch and hydrate during long gaming sessions!
You can organize your favorite games into custom folders in OmniLaunch for quick access!
Tapping the capture button takes a screenshot, and holding it saves the last 30 seconds of video!
Calibrating your analog sticks in System Settings helps fix any drifting issues!
Dark Mode themes in OmniLaunch help preserve battery life and reduce eye strain in handheld mode!
Cleaning the air vents occasionally keeps your Switch running whisper-quiet and cool!
Connecting Bluetooth headphones is seamless via Quick Settings in the top bar!
